_how: Display lines, hand-picked from the research quote. Unlisted cells: a clean quote (under 33 words, whole sentences) shows whole; anything else is hidden (still scored). Values: '=' whole quote, '-' hidden, [start, end] the verbatim stretch from the first phrase to the end of the second ('' = to the end), optional third item {cap:true} to capitalise a first letter when the stretch starts mid-sentence, {fix:[[from,to],...]} only for capitals on pronouns for God, and for typing marks a plain-text copy spells differently (a '--' for a dash, small capitals at the start of a book). Every shown line was checked against its source page (VERIFY.md). {stop:true} ends a stretch that stops at a comma or semicolon with a full stop. {note:'...'} prints a short fairness note under the line. {by:'...'} says who recorded words that are not the person's own pen. {use:{quote,work}} swaps in a line on the same position from research/figures (read in the source there).
